51595627.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to His-tagged LC3B (unknown origin) coupled to CM5 chip assessed as dissociation constant by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Biacore. The proteins to be measured (PCSK9 and LC3B in this experiment) were coupled to the CM5 sensor chip, and the small molecules to be measured (OY1–OY4 in this experiment) were prepared into solutions with different concentrations between 0 and 100 μM. The SPR signal was expressed as a response unit (RU) when the small molecule bound to or dissociated from the protein on the chip. When different concentrations of compounds flowed through the microarray coupled with PCSK9 or LC3B proteins, the SPR signals changed, and the dynamic binding, dissociation constants, and affinity of each compound with the protein were obtained. The His-Tag PCSK9 and His-Tag LC3B were purchased from Sino Biological, and the buffer used in the experiment is HBS-EP buffer purchased from Cytiva.
original_paragraph.Figure 3 caption: Figure 3. PCSK9-ATTECs have a certain affinity for both PCSK9 and LC3B in vitro. Biacore assays were carried out between OY1–OY4 and PCSK9/LC3B. The proteins to be tested (PCSK9 and LC3B in this experiment) were coupled to the CM5 sensor chip, and the small molecules to be tested (OY1–OY4 in this experiment) were prepared at different concentrations (0–100 μM). The surface plasmon resonance (SPR) signal changes were expressed in resonance units (response unit, RU).
